title: Self-Explaining Hate Speech Detection with Moral Rationales

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating group-based fairness metrics (GMB-Sub, GMB-BPSN, GMB-BNSP) to assess whether models over-target or unfairly treat specific identity subgroups (e.g., race, gender, religion, sexual orientation) mentioned in the text compared to the background distribution.

Comparing Large Language Model performance on the original Brazilian Portuguese dataset versus its English translation to demonstrate how cultural nuances, sarcasm, and context-dependent moral values are lost or misclassified across languages.
